handoff.manifest_contract: The existing WP-202 manifest owner, write paths, WP-201 dependency and acceptance items remain authoritative. These 16 repair packages partition issue #385, not the macro WP or its complete primary inventory. They are not new dispatchable WPs or a full-WP verification amendment.
handoff.verification: Use the existing WP-202 preflight/scaffold/inspect commands and immutable trusted-base change-scoped selection. Verification scope is android-scaffold. Do not copy Gradle selectors, check identities, suite minima or runtime evidence into this static handoff.
handoff.checks: Resolve current required_checks from automation-policy.json and the exact hosted task plan/results. Positive discovered/run counts and zero mandatory failures/errors/skips are required. No historical run or cache warmth establishes current acceptance.
handoff.candidate_scope: For each actual repair PR use the authenticated landed-wp-repair or landed-wp-verification contract, with exact base/head/tree/source/manifest/policy, changed paths and typed admissions, production consumer blobs, selected original families and executed methods. If a package is split across PRs, use new repair-<actual-issue-or-PR>- criterion IDs and retain these package IDs as traceability.
handoff.family_projection: Project source_path to coverage.cases.path, case_id to coverage.cases.id, retain parameter_family and include source_path in coverage.source_paths. Validate declaration_sha256 against the pinned catalog and source blob against test-cases.json. Preserve every original input, assertion-bearing helper and parameter family.
handoff.admission: Use WP-202 manifest paths for primary repository implementation/tests/evidence. For directly related cross-owner Kotlin consumers/tests use reviewed-support-consumer/modify-related-consumer and reviewed-support-test/add-or-update-related-test, with same-owner scope evolution and unchanged primary source ownership. Unknown paths or semantic overlap still fail closed.
handoff.execution: No worker, session, schedule or fleet activation. A later assigned producer uses one dedicated worktree/branch/PR per bounded candidate. WP-201 requires real merged prerequisite evidence, not an issue's closed state. support_producers names coordination and actual landed producer continuity, not new macro-WP dependency edges or a requirement to complete downstream WPs before this repair.
handoff.completion: Each package requires independent parity review of real assertions and relevant decisions. Bounded acceptance is wp_complete:false and dependency_unlock:false. Full WP-202 remains configured:false; this handoff cannot complete WP-202.

cm02_decision.criterion: Real Room-backed repository through the production coordinator, asserting persisted state and consumer-visible outcomes; no mounted App/UI flow is required.
cm02_decision.limitations: No substitute seam, helper-only assertion, source reachability or historical pass establishes the required integration. DATA-02 still requires its own actual user-flow boundary.
